notes.title: Farming Simulator 22 releases November 22nd.
notes.notes:
[b]Release-Date and Trailer for Farming Simulator 22 - pre-order now![/b]


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1248130/LandwirtschaftsSimulator_22/]Farming Simulator 22[/url] releases November 22nd, and you can pre-order now! Get the CLAAS XERION SADDLE TRAC Pack if you do. Also, if you want so secure yourself a limited PC Collector's Edition including a working beacon light and many other bonuses, you should not waste any time. It's only available while stocks last!

To celebrate the release date, there's also our first cinematic trailer. You can watch it below to get an atmospheric taste of the game. 

[b]
"It's a calling" - so, let the good times grow![/b]


[previewyoutube=tgv3RzTaxQM;full][/previewyoutube]

As new generations of farmers grow into the footsteps of their parents - in real-life or by the joy of playing Farming Simulator - we see our two protagonists, father and daughter, working the field together. Whether you play by yourself or together in multiplayer mode, the rewarding victory of harvested grapes will be worth it. Apropos grapes, want to know more about the new crops in Farming Simulator 22? We take a first look at our new crops, too. 


[b][h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1248130/LandwirtschaftsSimulator_22/]Pre-order now to get the CLAAS XERION SADDLE TRAC Pack![/url][/h2][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25636483/f94543bb84c5ae3c3160c3e6fcb7b292ec170011.png[/img]

Farming Simulator 22 releases for PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 4, Xbox One and Stadia on November 22nd. All pre-orders receive the CLAAS XERION SADDLE TRAC Pack to enjoy the CLAAS XERION 4200 SADDLE TRAC plus four more machines by KAWECO. Find the complete list of items below!

[b]CLAAS XERION SADDLE TRAC Pack[/b]

[list]
[*] CLAAS XERION 4200 SADDLE TRAC
[*] KAWECO XERION SADDLE TRAC Tanker
[*] KAWECO XERION SADDLE TRAC Semi-Trailed Tanker
[*] KAWECO OPTI-JECT 800

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25636483/c7103fd70bebb6acf8f5a2f67cfc18f02dcc7282.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Watch Farming Simulator 19's Launch Trailer!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lwjLakm.gif[/img]

[b]Farming Simulator 19 is out now on PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and PC/Mac![/b]

Discover the biggest and best Farming Simulator game ever, packed with new vehicles, activities, crops, animals, tools, and ways to play - solo or with friends.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z76GJnQmA6A
The Farming Simulator franchise has entranced millions of players over the years, thanks to its unique blend of progressive gameplay and rewarding management within the universal theme of farming and agriculture. Our new launch trailer highlights it all, and shows off the reworked graphics engine with its beautiful environments and models.

[b]With over 300 vehicles and tools[/b] to use from all the leading brands, including [b]John Deere[/b], Case IH, New Holland, Challenger, Fendt, Massey Ferguson, Valtra, Krone, Deutz-Fahr, and many more, it’s up to you how to specialize as you develop and expand your farm from one of three unique starting situations.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33245052/0d6a3488df5b519796e4578190c1c0d08240a487.jpg[/img]

Begin with no property but plenty of money to build the farm of your dreams, or go for a more hardcore playstyle of a small starting farm with limited resources - the choice is yours, along with which crops to grow, which animals to tend to, and which missions to attempt.

[b]New crops[/b] and [b]rideable horses[/b] massively expand your options from previous editions of the game, along with improved multiplayer that allows for up to 16 players (6 on console) to cooperate on or compete over the same map, each with their own tracts of land and equipment to use. Finally, enjoy an ever-expanding Farming Simulator experience by downloading community created mods on Consoles and PC/Mac!

[b]Farming Simulator 19 is out now for PlayStation 4, Xbox One, and PC/Mac. Get it now: [/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/787860/Farming_Simulator_19/

notes.title: Life on the Railroad!
notes.notes:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/39/1475226894-fs17-train-1.gif[/img]

Watch the latest Gameplay Trailer for Farming Simulator 17, and [b]discover a new way to quickly transport large quantities of wood and grain across the new and huge environment: drivable trains[/b].

Today's video will showcase the two train lines you can make use of as you travel along the railroads of Goldcrest Valley. Trains can be driven manually on these tracks. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xqLuJEqgXpw
The train is the fastest way to deliver your produce in large quantities. You will find several areas on the map that will allow you to stock, transfer or sell your grain and wood harvests directly from trains. 

Silos hold your grain, while conveniently placed heavy-duty cranes will allow you to transfer wood between trains or unload it at the sawmill to be processed and sold. 

[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/39/1475224348-farming-simulator-17-11-logo.jpg[/img]

Both lines meet at a central point in the playable area, where you will have the opportunity to transfer goods from one train to the other. 

For example, you might need to transport wood across half of the map, transfer it to the second train line, then transport it the other half to Stanton Sawmill where you can process it into wood chips and sell it. 

There is no risk of losing cargo, as the wagons are equipped with convenient fastening belts to ensure stability of your product. 

[b]Get on board on October 25, 2016 in Farming Simulator 17![/b]

notes.notes:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/35/1472809421-fs17-piggies-gif.gif[/img]

[b]Watch the latest Gameplay Trailer for Farming Simulator 17, and discover how to keep and tend animals![/b] There are more options for farmers than ever before, with the possibility to keep cows, sheep, chickens and, [b]for the first time in the series, pigs![/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lq8Mim-yTjM&feature=youtu.be
Players who properly tend to their animals will be able to bring in more income for their farms! Fresh straw for bedding and suitable food for each animal's diet means more wool from sheep flocks and more milk produced by cow herds.

Each animal requires a specially crafted diet, with a careful balance between different food types which you can grow yourself on your own farm. Many vehicles and tools, including many new pieces of equipment, are dedicated to the tending of animals - a selection of which you can see in the trailer. 

[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/35/1472807969-cochon-06-logo.jpg[/img]

Keep the feeding areas tidy and clean, properly feed and water your animals, and offer them fresh bedding regularly. Doing this will cause your animals' happiness to raise, maximizing their levels of reproduction. Keeping up with these needs means smart farmers can make a good profit by buying small groups of animals, then selling them in larger numbers after they multiply!

notes.title: Farming Simulator 17 Announcement
notes.notes:
[img]http://focus-files.com/presskit/farming17/screenshots/farming_simulator_17-01.jpg[/img]

[b]Giants Software and Focus Home Interactive announce Farming Simulator 17, coming to consoles and PC at the end of 2016.[/b]

Giants Software and Focus Home Interactive are pleased to announce today the continuation of their partnership for the release of Farming Simulator 17, arriving simultaneously on PC and consoles at the end of 2016. 

The game will be introduced for the first time during the What's Next of Focus Home Interactive press event organised in Paris, where journalists across the world can discover all upcoming titles released by Focus. There, they can also meet the developers of Farming Simulator 17 and discover some of the brand new features added to Giants Software's upcoming game.

"It's been a pleasure working with Focus throughout all these years. This partnership is the water on the seed that made Farming Simulator grow into the global phenomenon it is today. Each time we release a new version together we reach more people, and we look forward to expanding this reach even further in the coming years."
[i][b]Thomas Frey - Vice-President of Giants Software[/b][/i]

"Farming Simulator is a one of a kind story in the video game industry. Years ago, we imagined a unique destiny for this game and Giants Software, their creators. It is with great satisfaction that we succeed in reaching all of our objectives. There are still a lot of beautiful pages to write for Farming Simulator, and it starts right now with the simultaneous release of the game on PC and consoles at the end of the year."
[b][i]Cédric Lagarrigue - President of Focus Home Interactive[/i][/b]

notes.title: Pre-Purchase Now - Farming Simulator 17
notes.notes:
Farming Simulator 17 is Now Available for Pre-Purchase on Steam!

Those who pre-order Farming Simulator 17 will be able to play the Challenger MT700E Field Viper and the Valtra T-Series Cow Edition tractors on the day of release.

Farming Simulator 17, developed by Giants Software, invites you into the challenging world of a modern day farmer. Take on all the challenges of farming life, including animal husbandry, crops, sales, and woodcutting. You decide how you want to manage and grow your farm in a huge, open world!

As your career progresses, you’ll take control of over a hundred farming vehicles and machines, faithfully recreated from the biggest names in the industry (Challenger, Fendt, Valtra, Massey Ferguson, etc.) With deep, immersive gameplay, a large open world, and a huge fleet of vehicles including brand new machines, Farming Simulator invites you aboard the largest farming simulation ever created!
